name: Set your position
cue: Pin your hips and thighs; place the roller behind your lower calves.

name: Begin the curl
cue: Grip the handles and curl your heels down.

name: Curl back
cue: Keep your hips still as your heels move back.

name: Squeeze
cue: Finish the curl with your hamstrings; keep your back against the pad.

name: Controlled return
cue: Slowly extend your knees without letting the weight pull you.

name: Maintain tension
cue: Continue toward the start without letting the stack touch down.
